mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memo (title, body, pinned, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{body}, #{pinned}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.sql: id, title, body, pinned, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM memo ORDER BY pinned DESC, updated_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE memo SET title = #{title}, body = #{body}, pinned = #{pinned}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
